title: Pin the historical selected replay to its inspected commit
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The registered #6292 audit compared the current Makefile against a historical source pin. On [#7245](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7245), the scientific package passed and the [historical job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43019484467/job/130521242925) stopped at `working source drift: Makefile`.

Run the historical audit in a private sparse checkout of its inspected commit, `2485805a6d47f36ea83ddde6327d453ac82d44dc`, using that commit's authenticated inputs and planner. Preserve all 19 rejection cases on seven paths, the nine-package plan, and its empty-diff control. The separate navigation prerequisite points onboarding to the current #7000/#7001 replay using the exact #7147/#7156 documentation patch.

## Task and overlap

Canonical base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. This extracts the existing historical replay repair from [#7161](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7161), [#7164](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7164), and [#7244](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7244) for separate review. The two commits touch the CI guide and the historical package. The archived audit inputs and the selected result stay at their pinned records.

## Validation

At `d2e54af81f9dda6487636b79d4964a2385d89b2b` with CPython 3.12.3:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/historical-selected-replay-gap
python3.12 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_current_status.py
```

The registered replay passed with 19 rejections on seven paths and the nine-package historical plan. All six navigation tests passed. The affected-package plan selects just this historical replay. The same repair bytes passed the [historical job on #7244](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43018979337/job/130519563045). This PR verifies the historical audit and onboarding route.

## Credit

Credit unpaidmoon for #6292, Dennis for the historical replay gate, Matarener for the pinned-checkout precedent in #5434, and the #7147/#7156 navigation lineage. Prepared for Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Review the shared repair on its own. Branches that already carry the navigation fix can use the historical commit by itself.
